name: Badlands Reagent Run

faq.answer: Ghak Healtouch is an alchemist living in the dwarven settlement of Thelsamar within Loch Modan.
Thelsamar is a dwarf town located in the hills of Loch Modan, along the main road east of Ironforge.
The Badlands lie south of Loch Modan, reached through a rugged mountain pass.

sections.body: In the town of Thelsamar, Ghak Healtouch prepares his mixtures and finds his supplies running short. He needs raw reagents that can only be gathered from the harsh wastes of the Badlands to the south. You travel down through the mountain passes into the dry barrens to collect what he requires, then make the climb back to Loch Modan before his work comes to a halt.
sections.title: Supplies for Thelsamar

summary: Ghak Healtouch of Thelsamar needs rare reagents gathered from the arid wastes of the Badlands to continue his craft. Venturing south into the dry wilderness brings back the materials he requires before his concoctions can be finished.
attribution: In-game quest text: Badlands Reagent Run
